name: Monica
source:
A girl who was orphaned after a demon attack. She has bad habits and a tendency to wander. She loses her right hand when attacked by a demon, but the Giga Amoeba that Monica had raised transforms into her right hand to take its place.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071230090604fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/dangel/chara.html]Mink[/url]]
